author: claude:factory
source_detail: strategy-factory/reports/STRUCTURAL-01.md tested sum-to-one and spread-implies-moneyline. It did NOT test the containment between a first-five total and a full-game total, which is a separate identity and is checkable on tape already recorded.
thesis: Runs scored in the first five innings are a subset of runs scored in the whole game, so 'over 4.5 runs in the first five' cannot be more likely than 'over 4.5 runs in the game'. If the first-five market is ever dearer to buy than the full-game market is to sell at the same line, one of the two prices is wrong and no opinion about the game is needed.
unit: one recorded instant on one game

entry.when: For one game at one recorded instant, pair the first-five total with the full-game total at the SAME strike. Fire when ask(first five over X) + fee is below bid(full game over X) - fee, buying the first five and selling the full game. Both legs must be fillable at the recorded touch size and both must settle on the same game.

wrong_if: It fires fewer than 10 times across the whole recorded tape.
The locked profit after both fees is under 0.5 cents.
There is no size: a violation with nothing offered is an artefact, not money. K007 found 52 real ladder violations and 0 with tradeable size, and that is the expected outcome here.
The strikes do not actually line up, i.e. the two families use different strike conventions and my join is the bug rather than the market.
notes: STRUCTURAL, NOT A MENTALITY, and it is included as a BONUS rather than as one of the ten fleet slots - it needs no forward bot and can be run over tape already on disk. || EXPECTED RESULT: NOTHING. The general spread-implies-moneyline test found 0 violations in 172,684 instants. This is a different pair and has never been run, which is the only reason it is here. || Cost bar and ask depth are MEASURED off this project's own recorded tape, not assumed - src/mlb_cost.py, median over every two-sided touch recorded 2026-08-18 to 2026-09-03 between 5c and 95c, with the fee taken at that series' own rate from the census. Both sides of the real touch, never the mid. || Exit is HOLD TO SETTLEMENT on every spec here, deliberately. Mailbox 012: tennis measured exits properly and holding beat selling early in 5 of 5 mentalities, and mlb's own 81-configuration sweep had every stop-loss doing worse than holding. So the exit question is closed and nothing below varies it. These are ENTRY specs only.
